title: Assistance Given to Caregivers of Persons with Dementia
what_it_is: Assistance Given to Caregivers of Persons with Dementia

sections.label: Caregiver support and dementia subsidies
sections.summary: The Government provides support for caregivers, including enhanced long-term care subsidies, the Home Caregiving Grant, and AIC connections to caregiver services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government recognises the challenges that caregivers face and provides a range of support to help them, including those caring for persons living with dementia.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This is why the Government is enhancing long-term care subsidies including for Dementia Day Care and grants like the Home Caregiving Grant in 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To support the mental well-being of caregivers and equip them with coping skills, the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) connects caregivers to relevant services such as the Caregiver Support Network Community Outreach Teams (CREST-CSN) and the Post-Diagnostic Support Community Outreach Teams (CREST-PDS).

sections.label: Teams reach dementia persons
sections.summary: As of December 2024, seven teams have been set up and reached over 800 persons living with dementia and their caregivers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As of December 2024, seven teams have been set up and it has reached out to over 800 persons living with dementia and their caregivers.

sections.label: Respite care options
sections.summary: Respite care is available at over 130 senior care centres with dementia day care and over 60 nursing homes for up to a month a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If they need respite care for say, a few hours, they can have the elderly put up at one of over 130 senior care centres that provide dementia day care services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Those caring for seniors with higher care needs can tap on respite care in nursing homes, for up to a month for a year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are over 60 nursing homes offering nursing home respite care.

sections.label: Monitoring healthcare expenditure sustainability
sections.summary: As dementia numbers increase, the Government will continue to monitor and manage healthcare expenditure to ensure long-term fiscal sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As the number of people living with dementia increases, this is something that we will have to be concerned about and the Government will have to continue to monitor and manage our healthcare expenditure to ensure long-term fiscal sustainability.
